build_profiles.build: arm64 uncompressed Image (VA48/PA48) with forced diagnostic command line, GENI earlycon/console, configfs USB CDC-ACM (legacy g_serial disabled to avoid UDC contention), RPMh PHY rails, Qualcomm PON reboot-mode, and ABL framebuffer console; dtc -@ qcom/umi-csot.dtb; static rescue initramfs; Android boot header v2; WSL2 Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64, GCC 13.3.0, GNU make 4.3
build_profiles.status: Baseline f7d50a25 L2/L3 confirms rotate:3 framebuffer, configfs ACM, Windows COM6, and MiSeed help console. Android→Fastboot→Android passed. Current PDC-disabled diagnostic image 33b986f6 was RAM-booted; COM6 is present. Serial status confirms PON DT mode-bootloader=0x2, PMIC child nodes default available with valid two-cell reg properties, but c440000.spmi has no bound driver, /sys/bus/spmi/devices is empty, and qcom,pm8998-pon platform device is missing. CONFIG_QCOM_PDC=y candidate built at L2 but two RAM boots had no USB enumeration, with Android ADB returning once; PDC option was removed from current config. PON handoff, charging, and direct Linux→Fastboot remain incomplete; fallback Linux→Android→Fastboot→Android passed L3.
